summary: How jobs behave with instance groups: any instance in a group is equally likely to get a job, new instances add capacity to the cluster and their groups, a busy instance in several groups reduces capacity in all of them, and deprovisioning removes its capacity everywhere.
questions: How are jobs distributed across instances in an instance group?
Does an instance in multiple groups reduce capacity in all of them?
What happens to capacity when I deprovision an instance?
Do all instances need equal capacity?
